description: NASA’s Skyfall mission will test nuclear electric propulsion with the Space Reactor-1 Freedom spacecraft. Launching in 2028, it will deploy helicopter swarms on Mars to scout landing sites and search for water, potentially cutting travel time by 25%.
title: NASA Plans Nuclear-Powered Spacecraft for Skyfall Mission to Mars

description: Astronomers have directly imaged two giant planets forming around the young star WISPIT 2. The system, just 5.4 million years old, shows rings, gaps, and active planet formation, offering a rare real-time glimpse into how solar systems like ours are born.
title: Astronomers Capture Two Giant Planets Forming Around Young Star WISPIT 2

description: iQOO launched the Z11 in China on Thursday with a 6.83-inch AMOLED display offering a 165Hz refresh rate and powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 chipset. It features a 50-megapixel dual rear camera, 16-megapixel front camera, and a 9,020mAh battery with 90W fast charging. The phone runs Android 16-based OriginOS 6 and supports up to 16GB RAM and 512GB storage. Prices start at CNY 2,299 (roughly Rs. 31,200), and the handset is currently on sale in China.
title: iQOO Z11 Launched With 9,020mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 8500 SoC: Price, Features

description: Samsung has announced the India pricing and offers for the Galaxy A57 5G and Galaxy A37 5G, which were introduced on Wednesday. The phones feature 6.7-inch Super AMOLED+ displays with 120Hz refresh rates, Exynos chipsets, and 50-megapixel main cameras. They pack 5,000mAh batteries with fast charging and run Android 16-based One UI 8.5 with AI features. Prices start at Rs. 41,999. Both models are available for pre-order and will go on sale from April 2 with cashback and EMI offers.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G, Galaxy A37 5G Price in India, Offers Announced

description: Dell has refreshed its commercial PC portfolio with new Pro notebooks, the Pro 5 Micro desktop, Precision workstations, Pro P monitors, and accessories. The lineup focuses on thinner designs, improved thermals, and on-device AI support with enterprise-grade security features. The notebooks will launch from March and May, while workstations follow a similar timeline. The Pro 5 Micro offers Copilot+ capabilities, while Precision systems target heavy workloads. The monitors and accessories are already available, with select products launching in April.
title: Dell Pro Notebooks, Desktop PCs, Workstations Launched Alongside New Dell Pro P Monitors and Accessories

description: Apple launched the iPad (2025) last year with the A16 Bionic chip. Its successor may arrive soon, as an accessory listing hints at an updated model with a newer chipset and on‑device AI support. Recent reports say the 12th‑generation iPad is unlikely to feature major design or specification changes, and Apple has yet to announce any plans for a new iPad model.
title: Apple's iPad (2026) Seemingly Confirmed as Listing for Screen Protector Surfaces Online: Report

description: Apple is reportedly testing a 200-megapixel 1/1.12-inch camera sensor for future iPhones, signalling a possible shift towards higher resolution hardware. The same sensor is expected to feature in the Oppo Find X9 Ultra, which is tipped to offer dual 200-megapixel cameras and a 10x telephoto lens. While the leak remains unconfirmed, similar claims have surfaced before. A separate report suggested the iPhone 21 series, expected in 2028, could be Apple’s first lineup with a 200-megapixel sensor.
title: Apple Testing 200-Megapixel Sensor Expected to Debut on Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Tipster Claims

description: Ready Or Not Texas Season 1 offers a refreshing, unscripted journey filled with fun, travel, and friendship
title: Ready Or Not Texas Season 1: A Fun Korean Reality Journey Through Texas Now Streaming Online

description: Vivo V70 FE is set to launch in India on April 2 at 12pm IST, the company said in a press release. The handset was already confirmed to feature a 200-megapixel sensor at the back. The official Vivo India website has now revealed some other key details about the upcoming handset. It will be available in Monsoon Blue and Northern Lights Purple colourways. It will pack a 7,000mAh battery with support for 90W wired fast charging.
title: Vivo V70 FE India Launch Date Confirmed; Colour Options, Key Features Revealed

description: Oppo has announced that the Oppo K15 Pro series will launch in China in the first week of April. The new phones will arrive alongside fresh accessories, including the Oppo Watch X3 Mini and Oppo Enco Clip 2. Oppo recently introduced the K14 series in India, but it’s currently unclear whether the Oppo K15 Pro models will be launched in the country.
title: Oppo K15 Pro Series to Launch in China in April Alongside Oppo Watch X3 Mini, Enco Clip 2

description: A gripping revenge drama showcasing a soldier’s fight against injustice rooted in a tragic past.
title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge OTT Release Revealed: Where to Watch Ranveer Singh Starrer Online?

description: Apple has reportedly been granted full access to Google’s Gemini AI model, letting the iPhone maker use the same technology that powers Android devices. The company can now run Gemini in its own data centres for distillation, creating smaller, purpose‑built AI models. These compact models would work more efficiently on users’ devices and operate without needing an internet connection.
title: Apple Has 'Complete Access' to Google's Gemini Model; Can Create Smaller Models via Distillation: Report

description: Realme 16 5G India launch date has been announced by the company, and the handset will arrive in the country next month. The phone was first released in some global markets in January and comes with a Dimensity 6400 Turbo chip and a large 7,000mAh battery. It also features a horizontal rear camera setup that includes a 50‑megapixel main camera.
title: Realme 16 5G India Launch Date Set for April 2: Expected Specifications, Features

description: A heartfelt comedy-drama about a son trying to get his widowed father remarried to fulfill love and family expectations.
title: Durlabh Prasad Ki Dusri Shadi Now Streaming on JioHotstar: Cast, Story, and What to Expect

description: Oppo may soon expand its smartwatch lineup with the Watch X3 Mini, following a leaked render shared by Evan Blass. The device is expected to be a smaller version of the Watch X3, likely featuring a 43mm case. Based on last year’s launch pattern, it could arrive as early as April. The previous X2 series closely aligned with OnePlus models, but no smaller OnePlus Watch 4 has surfaced yet. The Watch X3 Mini may debut alongside the Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Oppo Pad Mini.
title: Oppo Watch X3 Mini Render Leak Hints at Smaller Design, Could Launch Soon

title: OTT Releases This Week (Mar 23 - Mar 29): Mardaani 3, O Romeo, Kaattaan, Daredevil: Born Again Season 2, and More
